visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a vertical collage of four photographs depicting a couple's journey over ten years, five years, two years, and the current year, including a pregnancy ultrasound and their toddler. A young woman with short brown hair then appears in a mirror selfie wearing a tan jacket and holding a pink smartphone in a brightly lit indoor subway or train station environment with people blurred in the background. (2) A screen recording shows a video call with a man wearing glasses, followed by a photo of the smiling couple; the man wears a white button-up shirt and makes a peace sign while the woman leans on his shoulder. They appear in a brightly lit retail or mall environment with clean architectural lines. Another shot shows the man in a denim jacket standing by a large yellow bird-headed art installation in a station. (3) The scene shifts to the present as the couple enters a modern restaurant with warm lighting; they walk down a staircase with a gold-lettered sign 夏慕尼 on the wall. Inside the restaurant, the man sits at a wooden table across from a small boy in a yellow bib, gesturing with his hands while speaking. The setting is upscale with professional indoor lighting and textured wall panels. (4) A culinary montage displays close-ups of A5 Wagyu beef being sliced and seared on a stainless steel teppanyaki grill, followed by a vibrant plate of fried rice with shrimp. The couple is shown clinking glasses filled with a light amber liquid, smiling brightly at the camera in a festive dining atmosphere. The man eats a green-topped dessert while the woman is seen wiping away tears from her eyes in a close-up shot. (5) In the final sequence, the couple looks through a commemorative photo book together at the dining table, laughing and smiling. They are then seen in a dimly lit aquarium exhibit with their child, observing a large blue projection or tank. The video ends with the man and child playing with a flexible blue robot toy on the restaurant table, with a waiter passing by in the background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 和日本老公在一起 第一年是台日遠距離. [Variety]: 十年前. 五年前. 兩年前. 今年. (2) [Subtitle]: 當時的我在努力打工 賺日本的學費. (3) [Subtitle]: 文當剛出社會第一年. (4) [Subtitle]: 我們彼此都沒有錢 一整年下來 只見了3次面. (5) [Subtitle]: 文當在我生日的時候 特地從日本飛來台灣 幫我慶生. (6) [Subtitle]: 十年前的我能想到 最高級的餐廳就是夏慕尼. (7) [Subtitle]: 真的成為我們兩個 很珍貴的回憶. (8) [Subtitle]: 今年我們剛好 帶兒子回台灣玩. (9) [Subtitle]: 毫不猶豫 我們決定10周年慶祝 也一定要選夏慕尼. (10) [Subtitle]: 我們點了十年前 不敢點的A5和牛龍蝦. (11) [Subtitle]: 香檳和檸檬冰沙 一直無限補充. (12) [Subtitle]: 櫻花蝦炒飯 也可以續. (13) [Subtitle]: 文當說台灣的鐵板燒 CP值太高了. (14) [Subtitle]: 還請店員幫我們照 跟10年前一樣的紀念照. (15) [Subtitle]: 吃甜點 回憶這十年的時候 我突然情緒一來 忍不住哭了. (16) [Subtitle]: 過了十年 很多事情都改變了 但很開心 身邊的人都還是彼此. (17) [Subtitle]: 十週年快樂. [Slogan]: 下一個十週年 要帶上長大後的麻糬 再來吃一次夏慕尼.
